app_id.rationale: The app_id is an identifier that scopes the config to a specific app; it does not control access, encryption, or security settings.

key_id.description: The key identifier of a private key enabled with DeviceCheck, created in your Apple Developer account.
key_id.rationale: key_id identifies which Apple Developer private key is used for DeviceCheck; it is a non-secret identifier that does not itself provide access to the key material.

private_key.description: The contents of the private key (.p8) file associated with the key specified by keyId.
private_key.rationale: DeviceCheck follows the Apple App Store's security guidelines and requires a private key for verification. Hardcoding this key or using an unencrypted format increases the risk of exfiltration. Using Secret Manager ensures encryption at rest and audit logging of key access.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Specifies the GCP project context; does not independently control access or security settings.

token_ttl.description:
Specifies the duration for which App Check tokens exchanged from DeviceCheck artifacts will be valid.
If unset, a default value of 1 hour is assumed. Must be between 30 minutes and 7 days, inclusive.

A duration in seconds with up to nine fractional digits, ending with 's'. Example: "3.5s".
token_ttl.rationale: The Token TTL (Time To Live) defines the window of validity for an App Check token. A shorter TTL limits the replay window for intercepted tokens. 24 hours (86400s) is the maximum recommended duration to balance user experience and security.
